en.title: Inspect a text conversion
en.statement: Inspect the complete example that keeps digit text under digits, converts it into count, then prints count plus one. Explain each subgoal before running and distinguish the stored numeric value from the final expression's result.
hints: Identify the original quoted digit string.
Follow the conversion result into count rather than back into digits.
Convert text 12 into numeric 12 before adding one to print 13.

steps.label: Keep the original text
steps.prompt: What kind of value do the quotes create?

steps.prompt: Which name receives the converted number?

steps.label: Use the numeric result
steps.prompt: Predict why the output is 13 rather than joined text.
